kebab_example: aliyun airec list-instance --page 1 --size 10 --status Running --name '测试实例' --expired-time 1608533404 --api-version 2018-10-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListInstance

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Valid values: 1 to 50
parameters.help_zh: 指定每页展示条数，默认为10，限制:[1-50]
parameters.name: size

parameters.help_en: The instance status used to filter instances. Valid values: Running, Ready, Initializing, and Starting
parameters.help_zh: 通过实例状态进行过滤。Running, Ready, Initializing,Starting
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The instance name used to filter instances. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 通过实例名称进行过滤，支持模糊匹配
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: A UNIX timestamp in seconds. Filters instances by expiration time. If the value is greater than the current time, instances that are about to expire are returned. Instances that have already expired are excluded
parameters.help_zh: 秒级时间戳，通过过期时间过滤，大于当前时间会过滤出即将过期的实例（不包含已经过期的实例）
parameters.name: expired_time

ChargeType.description_en:
The billing method. Valid values:
PrePaid: subscription.
PostPaid: pay-as-you-go.

Currently, only the subscription billing method is supported
ChargeType.description_zh: 付费类型，包含 包年包月（ PrePaid）和 按量付费 （ PostPaid ），当前产品只支持包年包月付费类型

DataSetVersion.description_en: The dataset version of the current online service
DataSetVersion.description_zh: 当前在线服务的数据集版本

ExpiredTime.description_en: The time when the instance expires, in UTC
ExpiredTime.description_zh: 实例过期时间，单位为UTC时间

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the instance was created, in UTC
GmtCreate.description_zh: 实例创建时间，单位为UTC时间

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the instance was last modified, in UTC
GmtModified.description_zh: 实例最后更新时间，单位为UTC时间

Industry.description_en:
The industry name. Valid values:
content: content-based.
item: commodity-based.
news: news-based.
video: video-based.
sns: social networking-based
Industry.description_zh: 行业名称，行业名称分为：内容型（ content ）、商品型（ item ）、新闻型（ news）、视频型（ video ）、社交型（ sns ）

LockMode.description_en:
The lock status. Valid values:
Unlock: The instance is not locked.
ManualLock: The instance is manually locked.
LockByExpiration: The instance is locked due to overdue payment
LockMode.description_zh: 锁定状态，包含 未锁定（ Unlock ）、手动锁定（ ManualLock ）、欠费锁定 （ LockByExpiration）

RegionId.description_en: The region where the instance resides

Status.description_en:
The instance status. Valid values:
Initializing: The instance is being initialized.
Ready: The instance is ready for data import.
Running: The instance is running
Status.description_zh: 实例状态，初始化中（Initializing）、待数据导入（Ready）、运行中（Running）

Type.description_en: The instance type. Currently, only Standard is supported
Type.description_zh: 实例类型，当前只有 标准版（Standard）
